name: PulseGuard
tagline: Early warning for patient deterioration, before it's too late
problem: Ward patients deteriorate silently between manual observation rounds
Understaffed district hospitals: one nurse, many beds, paper charts
Paper NEWS2 is a snapshot; nobody plots the trend
Threshold alarms fire only after the patient has crossed the line

stats.label: in-hospital arrests showed deterioration in prior 8 h (Schein 1990, approx.)
NEWS2 minimum obs interval for scores 1–4 (RCP 2017)

solution: Exact NEWS2 scoring of every reading, incl. SpO2 Scale 2 for COPD
From-scratch trend detector projects NEWS2 4 h ahead
Acuity-sorted ward dashboard with alert feed and escalation steps
Explainable breakdown, bedside calculator and auto handover

features.title: NEWS2 engine
features.desc: All 7 parameters, Scale 1/2, red-3 rule, 4 bands, RCP responses

features.title: Trend early warning
features.desc: OLS slopes + R² gating flag rising risk before thresholds

features.title: Explainability
features.desc: Per-parameter points, zone-shaded charts, rule that fired

features.title: Bedside calculator
features.desc: Validated entry, instant score, save to patient chart

features.title: Auto handover
features.desc: Printable per-patient summary: score, trend, last change

architecture: Ward simulator / nurse entry -> validated vital-sign readings
news2.py -> RCP 2017 tables, bands, escalation response
trend.py -> least-squares slope, R², 4 h projection
Vanilla JS + inline SVG dashboard, polls every second
algorithms: NEWS2 (RCP 2017) – aggregate risk score and clinical response
Ordinary least squares – per-vital slope and R² over 3 h
Trend projection – score projected vitals with NEWS2
Hysteresis state machine – alert without flicker spam
AR(1) physiological simulator – seeded deterministic vitals
innovation: Warns on the trajectory, not just the threshold
Early warning stated in NEWS2 terms nurses already use
Scale 2 prevents constant false red alerts in COPD
Fully offline, explainable, runs on a ₹15k laptop

results.label: median extra warning vs NEWS2≥5 alert (held-out sim)
median earlier than 4-hourly paper rounds (held-out sim)
false trend alerts per stable patient-days (held-out)

demo_flow: Click Run demo: 12-bed ward plays from 08:00
Bed 1 gets a purple early warning while NEWS2 is still low
Open patient: per-parameter breakdown, shaded charts, slopes
Threshold fires 1 h 45 min later; acknowledge alert
COPD bed: Scale 2 vs Scale 1 comparison
Bedside calculator: Early sepsis example scores 7
Handover tab: print the auto-generated summary
impact: More time for antibiotics, fluids or ICU transfer
Points scarce nursing attention at the beds that need it
No licence, cloud or new hardware needed to start
Consistent, printable handovers on every shift
business: Free bedside calculator to drive adoption
Per-bed monthly subscription for ward dashboard
Bundle with low-cost wearables via state health missions/CSR
Analytics add-on: escalation compliance for quality teams
future: Validate on real de-identified vitals, then silent ward pilot
